admission.justification: Retirement at master landing was explicitly rejected, and the retained command, database reader and version bind later cleanup work.

alternatives.option: Retain knowledge-convert, its read-only legacy database reader and conversion-format version 1 as permanent product parts.
alternatives.reason: They remain the only supported path for an unseen legacy line to reach the text format.
Landing this master supplies no census of unconverted lines in other clones or machines.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A separate developer breaking-change decision explicitly authorizes removing the command, read-only reader or conversion-format version.

consequences: No task cleanup silently retires any of the three.
The converter validates before file writes and makes no Git commit; first conversion/adoption/landing remain with their own owners.
context: Legacy lines can remain in other clones and machines, so this build cannot know that the last unconverted line is gone. MIK-R46 rule 7 explicitly weighs retirement when the master lands.
decider: Developer direction and approved MIK-R46@v2 rule 7.

evidence: requirements/MIK-R46-v2-conversion-precedes-ordinary-memory-operations.md under D39(b)/D47; rule 7 rejects retire when this master lands.
